title: MdifBridgeStart
description: Request Argos to start a bridge to an MDIF device.

type.description: Type of bridge to create. 'tcp' creates a TCP socket bridge, 'tls' creates a TLS socket bridge, while 'ws' creates a WebSocket bridge.

deviceId.description: Device ID of the MDIF device.
